chunks: And plunged into useless things with those who were obstinate,

key_terms.الْخَائِضِينَ: those who engage in idle talk or obstinate disputers
key_terms.نَخُوضُ: to plunge or engage in idle talk/debate

ai.seo_question: What does 'khanada' mean in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the pre-Islamic era of Jahiliyyah, illustrating the believers' participation in the casual, sometimes frivolous, discourses of the Meccan elite before the advent of prophetic clarity. It underscores the transformative power of divine revelation, which purified their hearts and redirected their focus from idle chatter to the remembrance of God and the Hereafter.
